CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Assignments.Title: Use Case Scenarios & Requirements Specification
Assignments.TopicTitles: Introduction to Use Case Scenarios, Identifying Stakeholders and Users, Requirements Gathering Techniques, Task Analysis, Writing Use Case Scenarios, Enumerating Usage Paths and Edge Cases, Documenting and Communicating Requirements
Assignments.ExtraInstructions:
This assignment is all about gathering and developing specifications for the project. All stakeholders should be identified. All actions that can be performed with the software project should be identified and both use case scenarios and task analysis should be given for each of these actions. 

Actions that are common among all apps, such as logging in only need to specify any distinct requirements that set them apart from other standard applications. All actions that are unique or core to the application should inlcude additional details.
